name: Lancegill
source:
The personal guard and magician of Kiral. He is a man of few words, and is careful in choosing his words. He is loyal to Kiral, and tries his best to fix his behavior.

He is the kingdom's strongest knight and leader of the royal guard. He is also proficient enough in magic to be Kiral's personal magician.
